vast.name: Vast.ai
vast.note: Index of verified-host listings refreshed from the madebyagents.com GPU-rental price index, which aggregates the Vast.ai public API — figures are pulled via that third-party index, not queried from Vast.ai directly. Vast.ai figures are the cheapest offer found ('from' prices, spot tier) — the marketplace moves hourly, so treat these as directional. Pulled 2026-09-29 ~14:00 UTC. H100 = H100 SXM 80GB HBM3 variant. RTX 4080 and RTX A6000 cells retain the 2026-09-28 pull ($0.17 / $0.13): today's pull showed no cheaper Vast.ai spot headline for those SKUs. A100 cell retains the 2026-09-27 aitooldiscovery snapshot ($0.75): the 2026-09-28/29 pulls listed only 80GB A100 variants, which do not match this row's 40GB SXM4 SKU.

saladcloud.name: SaladCloud
saladcloud.note: Official published 'from' rates on the Lowest priority tier (four tiers: High, Medium, Low, Lowest — lower tiers can be preempted by higher-priority workloads). Per-second billing while instances run. List prices changed 2026-09-12; figures captured 2026-09-29: RTX 3090 $0.09, 4090 $0.16, 5080 $0.15, 5090 $0.25. Only these four GPUs publish list rates on the pricing page.
